sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith Master - Part 7 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "This one is for Sniper, it seems that he’s about to set out to the woods somewhere to hunt down villains for a week. Judging from the fact that he packed one hell of a backpack with an MRE, firesteel, batteries, and water. Left it at my place for now. He needs an M1A, fitted with an UltiMAK M8 Forward Optic mount, Nightforce ATACR 7-35x56 scope, Micro T-1 reflex sight, Holosun LS321 tactical device, and a 20-round mag. Ergonomics above 20, recoil sum below 400, and a total weight of 7.3 kg or less."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 37 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an M1A to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +26,600 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.03
- 500 Euros
  - 525 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 575 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× AR-15 Hera Arms CQR pistol grip/buttstock
- 1× Hera Arms CQR tactical foregrip
- Unlocks purchase of AR-10 KAC QDC 7.62x51 Muzzle Brake Kit at Mechanic LL3
- Unlocks purchase of Magpul MOE Carbine rubber buttpad at Peacekeeper LL4
"The rifle is ready? Great. I guess you have already figured out that Sniper's real name is Dima, I let it slip a while ago. Not a word about him to anybody, I hope you understand."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
M1A specifications:
- 60 Durability
- 20 or more ergonomics
- 400 or less recoil
- 7.3 kg or less in weight
- A magazine with a capacity of at least 20
- M14 UltiMAK M8 Forward Optic mount
- Nightforce ATACR 7-35x56 34mm riflescope
- Aimpoint Micro T-1 reflex sight
- Holosun LS321 Tactical device

sections.heading: Build
sections.text: This is one example of many possible configurations.

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard M1A from Peacekeeper LL3.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
